engine: Medicines and documents (tablet, syrup, prescription, report, injection, blood test, X-ray, scan) share the health group with illnesses, so they get the to-me form. Only real illnesses and pains take nanage/enakku; things you hold take hatra/kitta. Wrong: 'nimage syrup ideyaa?' / 'ungalukku syrup irukkaa?' Right: 'nimma hatra syrup ideyaa?' / 'unga kitta syrup irukkaa?'. Wrong: 'nanage prescription ide' / 'enakku prescription irukku'. Right: 'nanna hatra prescription ide' / 'en kitta prescription irukku'. Same for 'nanage tablet ide' (right: 'nanna hatra tablet ide') and 'enakku maathirai irukku' (right: 'en kitta maathirai irukku').

Understand takes the to-me form, not I. 'naanu lesson artha maadkolalla' means 'I will not bother to understand'. Right: 'nanage lesson artha aagalla'. Tamil 'naan lesson purinjukka maatten' means 'I refuse to understand'. Right: 'enakku lesson puriyala'.
'Where do I sign?' is built as a plain present statement. Wrong: 'naanu elli sign maadtini' / 'naan enga sign pannuren'. Right: 'elli sign maadbeku?' / 'enga sign pannanum?'.

'Come back' plus 'again' says again twice in Tamil and is redundant in Kannada. Wrong: 'thirumba thirumbi vaanga' / 'innomme vaapas banni'. Right: 'thirumba vaanga' / 'innomme banni'. Use the plain come verb when again is added.

'Where is my...' uses the respectful they-form for everyone, which sounds odd for your own child or wife. Wrong: 'nanna maga elli iddaare?', 'nanna magalu elli iddaare?', 'nanna hendti elli iddaare?', 'nanna magu elli iddaare?'. Right: 'nanna maga elli iddaane?', 'nanna magalu elli iddaale?', 'nanna hendti elli iddaale?', 'nanna magu elli ide?'. Tamil wrong: 'en paiyan enga irukkaanga?', 'en ponnu enga irukkaanga?', 'en pondaatti enga irukkaanga?', 'en kozhandhai enga irukkaanga?'. Right: 'en paiyan enga irukkaan?', 'en ponnu enga irukkaa?', 'en pondaatti enga irukkaa?', 'en kozhandhai enga irukku?'. Parents, elder siblings, husband and workers keep the respectful form.

Tamil plain place word for home: placePlain strips 'kku' from 'veetukku' and leaves the joining form 'veetu'. Wrong: 'veetu enga irukku?'. Right: 'veedu enga irukku?'. Add home: 'veedu' to a Tamil override table like the Malayalam one.

Picking up a person needs the object ending. Wrong: 'magu ivattu pick up maadi' / 'kozhandhai innikki pick up pannunga'. Right: 'magunna ivattu pick up maadi' / 'kozhandhaiya innikki pick up pannunga'.

English glosses use the wrong article. Wrong to right: 'Where is the Bangalore?' to 'Where is Bangalore?'; 'Where is the home?' to 'Where is home?'; 'Please show a token' to 'Please show your token'; 'Please pick up a child today' to 'Please pick up the child today'; 'Please keep a parcel outside' to 'Please keep the parcel outside'; 'Please attend a meeting' to 'Please attend the meeting'; 'Please pay a fine' to 'Please pay the fine'; 'How much is a fine?' to 'How much is the fine?'; 'Please give me menu' to 'Please give me the menu'; 'Please give me bill' to 'Please give me the bill'; 'Please pack biryani' to 'Please pack the biryani'; 'I have prescription' to 'I have a prescription'; 'I have report' to 'I have the report'; 'Please give me a little chillies' to 'Please give me a few chillies'; 'I'm reaching to the office' to 'I'm reaching the office'; 'Please switch off electricity' to 'Please switch off the power'.
